description: This file defines an interface IPasswordHasher for hashing passwords asynchronously, including a method Hash that takes a password and a salt as inputs.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: Interface for a password hashing service that supports asynchronous hashing and cleanup via IDisposable.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password using a provided salt, returning the hash bytes.
